articles.title: Peyton Watson To Cavaliers On Four-Year, $88M Deal; Max Strus To Clippers
articles.description: The Cleveland Cavaliers have acquired Peyton Watson in a sign-and-trade with the Denver Nuggets and Los Angeles Clippers. Watson will sign a four-year, $88 million deal with a player option and a trade kicker. Max Strus will be traded to the Clippers, while the Nuggets will receive a 2031 first round pick via the Cavaliers and a 2032 second rounder via the Kings. The Clippers will acquire the $16.6 million Strus contract using the $17 million John Collins trade exception. Watson slides in as the Cavaliers' starting small forward and can also play small ball power forward in certain lineups. Watson was a restricted free agency and the Nuggets had significant salary cap issues in retaining him, especially after committing a five-year, $125 million extension to Christian Braun last October. Watson also received interest from the Milwaukee Bucks and Portland Trail Blazers in restricted free agency.
